name: swanson
about: oak planks fall into place, pixel-art Ron Swanson rises on the right beside one of his quotes on a pinned card, then he sinks away and the planks fall out below

licence.assets: kiosk/art/swanson.png (Ron, 160x160, drawn at 3x) and kiosk/art/swanson-wood.png (the oak, 1920x515) are Nula's pixel art; their licence is still to be confirmed with Nula. The quotes come from the Ron Swanson Quotes API. Ron Swanson is Parks and Recreation's (NBC), played by Nick Offerman: an unofficial fan tribute, for our own kiosks
